title: Holo edge
what: Exactly the locked content: the Standard's head, title and rows 01–06, nothing added. The form adds a real page thickness (a ruled, foil-cut edge folded back in 3D), a foil hairline on the top edge, foil laminate on the two drafts behind with blank placeholder lines, and corner registration ticks.
why: The cut edge of the pad carries the same holographic foil as the contributor pass further down, so the hero document and the pass read as one set: the Standard is a thick, growing body of pages, and the pass is your seat in it. Foil stays on the edges and drafts (the open, still-forming parts), while the only orange is row 06, the place for you.
how: Four 30px faces fold back from the sheet's edges (preserve-3d), ruled with 1px neutral-800 page lines; foil is the pass gradient's cool half (chart-6, chart-9, primary-200, chart-3) on an oversized band slid by transform with the pointer, damped like the tilt. On load drafts settle, the sheet lands, its pages fold out from zero depth, the foil sweeps once and rows write in, all in about 1.2s; reduced motion shows the final state with no foil travel, and on mobile the 3D is flat with the drafts as a 2D pad edge below and right.
